pending.body: In nitrogen_cycle.rs, after the comammox step (around line 350), `alk_budget` is not decremented by `comammox_alk_cost`, while `do_budget` IS always decremented after each step. Since nothing reads `alk_budget` after comammox this is harmless today, but if a future step (e.g. denitrification) needs the running alkalinity budget for rate-limiting, the stale value would silently over-allocate. Add `alk_budget = (alk_budget - comammox_alk_cost).max(0.0);` after line 350 to match the DO budget pattern and prevent a latent accounting bug.

In engine.rs, `StageTrace::metric()` unconditionally allocates `BudgetMetric` (including a heap `String` for the label) even when neither budget tracking nor tracing is enabled. For the nitrogen_cycle stage alone this is 5 allocations per tick, silently dropped if no budget ledger exists. Guard the allocation: either check `ctx.budget.is_some()` before calling `metric()`, or make `metric()` a no-op when a `budget_active` flag is false — similar to how `note()` already guards on `self.enabled`.
